basics.name: Leonardo Monteiro da Silva
basics.label: Full Stack Developer & Tech Lead
basics.summary: Full Stack Developer with four years of experience building and maintaining TypeScript, Node.js and React applications for a production SaaS on Google Cloud, used by 30,000+ clinics. Delivered 80+ features and resolved 1,600+ support tickets in the platform's financial module, introduced automated testing (Jest/TDD) to the team, and now lead the module's migration to a micro-frontend architecture. Currently lead a 6-developer team and am pursuing a Software Engineering degree at UNINTER.

work.name: Clinicorp Solutions
highlights: Lead a team of 6 developers (1 junior, 4 mid-level, 1 senior) within a 10-person squad, while contributing hands-on as the top committer of the new financial micro-frontend (54% of its commits)
Own technical decisions and code quality for the squad, having reviewed 800+ pull requests since 2023

Architected and stood up the new financial module as a TypeScript micro-frontend (React, Vite) and lead its incremental migration off the legacy JavaScript module: two screens (checking account, NFSe issuer setup) live in production, six modules under way and 200+ test files in the new codebase

Automate the squad's workflow with Claude Code: built a pull request review skill (blind oracle, nine specialized analyzers, adversarial pass), a twice-daily regression radar over support tickets reporting to Google Chat, and skills for branch closing, preview deploys and UI test runs; contribute to the engineering team's internal plugin marketplace

work.name: Clinicorp Solutions
highlights: Delivered 80+ features in the financial module of a SaaS used by 30,000+ dental clinics and 200,000+ active users, authoring 290+ merged pull requests in React, Node.js and TypeScript on Google Cloud (Datastore, Pub/Sub) within a Scrum/Kanban squad
Refactored and maintained legacy code, resolving 12 technical debt items and fixing around 100 bugs across the system
Drove adoption of automated testing (Jest/TDD), creating and maintaining 30+ test suites across nearly 40 pull requests to improve code reliability and maintainability
Resolved 1,600+ production support tickets in the financial module, debugging with Grafana, Loki and Google Cloud logs and reprocessing Pub/Sub messages in production

Built and maintained integrations between the financial module and four external systems: the in-house fintech, Saúde Service (card payments), Focus (NFSe issuing) and CDL/SPC (credit lookups and SPC debt registration)
Authored the financial module's observability dashboards in Grafana over Prometheus, Loki and Tempo, used by the squad for dashboard and alert monitoring
